source: Re-measured by the maintainers after the 2026-11-01 changes, which replay each of a clip's four copies in its own Isaac process with a scene of its own: the reference PD targets (solution/reference/) graded by tests/ in the task image, offline (--network none), twice: mean_clip_score=0.9781538421235181 both times, the 36 copies' errors bitwise identical. 34 of the 36 copies score 1.0; P0001_624f2ba9_seg009 copy 2 scores 0.82 and P0001_624f2ba9_seg013 copy 3 0.40. The contributor's runs (validate-5894a231, validate-277fea36, validate-7ff7879f, validate-a581fa34, validate-e19240e5: 1.0 each) replayed a clip's four copies in one shared PhysX scene, where they changed each other's results. full_at 0.95 leaves margin for about two more copies drifting on other hardware.
